title: Operations inventory
description: The coverage checklist every later phase reports against. Produced by mapper; outcome fields filled in by whoever touches the operation. Not a URL list, and no vulnerability hypotheses.

area.description: Feature area or plugin the operation belongs to.

method.description: HTTP verb, or UI/RPC/CLI for non-HTTP operations.

auth_required.description: unknown is legitimate at map time but must resolve before the owning module completes.

module.description: Which state.json module owns this operation. The join key gate_module_complete.py uses; without it coverage cannot be enforced.

source_ref.description: file:line of the route registration (source mode) or the request that revealed it (web mode).

declared_privilege.description: Authorization the code claims to require, verbatim. Source mode: the security.authz / RestHandler privilege block.

outcome.description: null until decided. Every operation gets one explicitly; none are ever dropped.

outcome_reason.description: Required in practice for blocked/excluded/not_applicable — those are meaningless without one.

finding_ids.description: Findings this operation produced, if any.
